description: Electron-builder fails to compile a TypeScript configuration on Windows because config-file-ts creates a cache folder containing a drive-colon path, based on https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/issues/7572.
prompt:
I converted my `electron-builder` config to TypeScript and now Windows packaging fails before it gets to NSIS. Is this my tsconfig or something in the builder?

```
Could not write file 'C:/Users/runner/.cache/config-file-ts/:-repo-starlane-electron-.electron-builder.config.ts/repo/starlane/electron/.electron-builder.config.js': EINVAL: invalid argument, mkdir 'C:/Users/runner/.cache/config-file-ts/:-repo-starlane-electron-.electron-builder.config.ts'.
```
